'''2016 EGP Chris Wirfs LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirfs]] at [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Wirfs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-endor-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
